name: Gudgodah
overview: Gudgodah is identified in Scripture as a specific station where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey. The passages in Numbers 33:32-33 and Deuteronomy 10:7 connect Gudgodah with Hor-Hagidgad, suggesting they are likely the same location. These verses trace the orderly progress of the people of God as He faithfully led them through the wilderness, underscoring the historical reality of their journey and God's providential guidance.
